Package com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage

Class JobMetadata

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.logmessage.JobMetadata
  • public class JobMetadata
extends Object
    Owns the descriptive metadata of a Job: correlation/parent/external log ids and the business fields. All of it is transmitted to the nJAMS server with the job's log messages. Mutators return this facet for call chaining. Obtain via job.metadata().
